terms.definition: AC generator end that converts mechanical power into electrical power
complete power-generation unit combining a prime mover and an alternator with control and support subsystems
notes: Abbreviated to GenSet in common use.
Diesel and natural gas are the common fuels.

terms.definition: declared power a generator set may deliver under a stated duty
notes: ISO 8528 defines Emergency Standby Power (ESP), Prime Power (PRP), Continuous Power (COP) and Limited-Time Power (LTP). Data-Centre Continuous (DCC) is an industry duty beyond that set.
